dedupe_keys.name: soil and landscape grid digital soil attribute maps for queensland series

description: Soil and Landscape Grid Digital Soil Attribute Maps for Queensland series is a dataset listed in Queensland Government open data portal (data.qld.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Environment, Tourism, Science and Innovation. These datasets describe soil attributes suitable for inclusion in the TERN Soil and Landscape Grid of Australia ( clw. csiro. au/aclep/soilandlandscapegrid). Eleven attributes are available in raster format at a resolution of 3 arc-seconds (approximately 90m). These products are generated using spatial modelling and digital soil mapping techniques. Coverage: Queensland. The portal files it under the publisher Environment, Tourism, Science and Innovation. It offers 12 resource(s) in spatial data format, xml. The portal shows 2023-02-20 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-queensland-government-open-data-portal.
